sloka: पुष्पेषूपहृतेष्वेवं रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।अवतीर्णो नदीं स्नातुं गङ्गामिव महागजः ।। ७.३१.३८ ॥
transliteration: puṣpeṣūpahṛteṣvevaṁ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।avatīrṇo nadīṁ snātuṁ gaṅgāmiva mahāgajaḥ ।। 7.31.38 ॥

translations.english: When the flowers were thus brought, Ravana, the lord of Rākṣasas, descended into the river to bathe, just like a great elephant entering the Ganga.
